title: build(deps): bump konva from 10.3.2 to 10.7.0
intent: Routine dependency currency, no security advisory. Adopt Konva 10.7.0 bug fixes while preserving the existing client integration.
behavior_change: Only Konva moves from 10.3.2 to 10.7.0 in the manifest and lockfile. No unrelated direct or transitive package version changes occur. Upstream 10.6/10.7 changes improve pointer, bounds, serialization, path, image, text, and rendering behavior; the repository uses basic Stage/Layer/Path/Circle/Rect/Ellipse APIs and does not call the removed Stage.bufferCanvas or three-argument drawScene API.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Bumped the direct konva declaration and the single resolved node_modules/konva lock entry from 10.3.2 to 10.7.0. No other package version or integrity entry moved.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot routine-currency update. The repository currently resolves 10.3.2 and has no other open Konva bump.

commands_run: cd packages/client && npm run check:node && npm run build
cd packages/client && npm run type-check  # existing repository-wide failures; identical Konva-related failures reproduced on 10.3.2 and 10.7.0

files.intent: Pin Konva 10.7.0 tarball and integrity metadata.
files.behavior_change: Only the Konva lock entry changes.

files.intent: Provide the PR-owned CBSP21 dependency-bump manifest.

findings: LOW: client canvas dependency update. Repository usage avoids removed internal APIs; the production build covers public API compatibility. The full type-check has pre-existing failures, but the Konva-related diagnostics are identical on 10.3.2 and 10.7.0. Interactive and pixel-level rendering remain residual smoke-test risk.
architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Single-package client dependency bump with no application-code or architecture change.
